Do I Need International Credential Evaluation Services in San Francisco?

If you obtained some of your education outside the United States, a foreign credential evaluation service will provide the U.S. equivalency. This way, educational institutions, government agencies, immigration offices, etc. can better understand your academic background. Every year, we process thousands of translations and all of them are accepted.

There are three main types of reports that our San Francisco international credential evaluation services can provide:

1. General report. A foreign credential evaluation report, aka degree evaluation, confirms the authenticity of your academic documents and program of study.

2. General report with GPA. This report provides the same as general but adds a cumulative GPA.

3. Course by course. A course by course report lists your individual coursework and includes the U.S. equivalent course title, grade and credits.
